logline: A courier sprints across a dusk rooftop and hands a parcel to a delivery drone a second before the light dies.

hook.opening: Mid-sprint: low tracking shot at shoe level as the courier vaults a rooftop vent, the sun flaring behind her.

beats.summary: Handoff to the drone and its lift-off.

characters.acting_baseline: Focused and economical; breathes hard but never panics; small satisfied exhale after the handoff.

visual_plan: Warm low sun against cool shadows; the courier's teal jacket is the only saturated cool colour. Handheld energy in the chase, locked-off calm for the release.

audio_policy.sfx: diegetic only: footsteps on gravel, breath, wind, drone rotors
